what: The Weekly Dispatch launch announcement and issue 001's share post (Newsletter doc). Not a dispatch, no number.

caption:
The Weekly Dispatch is live, and issue 001 is out this morning.

On 25 October 1944, six little carriers and seven escorts woke up to find the biggest battleship ever built bearing down on them. This is the story of what they did next.

Every Sunday, one free email tells one remarkable story from that week in the war, in full, with archival photos and the sources behind it.

Read it free: https://ww2dispatches.substack.com/p/the-last-stand-of-taffy-3

#WW2
